title: Layer Visible And Locked Controls

oracle.positive: Toggle visible/locked on Gems affects viewport and picking immediately
oracle.negative: Locked object edit attempt must have no mutation and informative status

reviewer.role: project owner (human reviewer) at the running application

checks_run: RED: cargo test -p om9-app --test layer_visible_locked -> 1 passed; 2 failed. Product defect: moving an object OFF a locked layer was allowed (only the target lock was checked).
cargo test -p om9-core -p om9-app -j 2: every group passes except the pre-existing, unrelated chrome_actions::icons_scale_with_the_screen_size.
cargo fmt --check: exit 0; cargo clippy -p om9-core -p om9-app --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0

Integrity audit (round 34): the new tools/audit_m01_l2_03_14.py checks that every file the eight records cite is on disk (design api.md + crosswalk, both fixtures, the ui-review, every artefact it names, and a ledger entry) and reports: integrity: 0 problem(s) across 8 L3. Output saved as implementation/evidence/M01/OM9-L2-03-14/INTEGRITY_AUDIT.log.
code_change: crates/om9-app/src/session/layers.rs::assign_layer refuses a source whose entity or owning layer is locked, before any action is planned (Permission("object is on a locked layer")); no transaction, no mutation.

manual_reviewer_checklist.scope_note: The flags and refusals are machine-proven; the look of the two controls is yours to confirm.

items.machine_proven: S1/S2: its objects become non-visible and non-selectable at once and select_layer selects nothing.
items.human_must_verify: The objects disappear from the viewport immediately and cannot be clicked.

items.machine_proven: S3: visibility, selectability and the scene entry come back in the same call.
items.human_must_verify: The objects reappear in their layer colour and can be picked.

items.step: Lock Gems and try to move one of its objects to another layer.
items.machine_proven: T1/T2: refused before anything is applied, with 'locked' in the message; entities and journal unchanged.
items.human_must_verify: Nothing moves, the status names the lock, and Undo is not needed.

items.step: Look at a locked layer's rows.
items.machine_proven: T4: display attributes stay complete (name, layer, flags).
items.human_must_verify: A locked layer still shows its objects and colours; only editing is refused.
